method: Post-freeze, label-aware zero-call paper walkthrough of a proposed entity-attribute-or-action-time-span support contract on the two decisive election failures.

mechanisms.result: The unique frozen end-span supports an alternate action but omits the reference-level action. A label-blind support check cannot detect the omission; accepting the entity alias repeats the wrong answer, while rejecting it repeats locator-based false abstention.

Two frozen text spans both satisfy the question because it has no temporal qualifier. The tuple check must verify rather than uniquely select the reference span; selecting it requires an additional, unvalidated salience or text-type rule.

decision_disposition: Do not launch the proposed 24-call task-support follow-up
reconsider_when: A treatment-frozen eligibility audit identifies fresh answer-sufficient targets with a uniquely recoverable requested entity, fact, and span, or a separate evidence-recovery experiment is authorized.
privacy: No row IDs, questions, references, evidence text, predictions, or raw responses are included.
